clauses.requirement: The rear lamp shall comply with the administrative provisions of UN R148 paragraph 3 governing the type approval application and its accompanying documentation.
The application for approval of the rear lamp type shall be made and handled in accordance with UN R148 paragraph 3.1 (Application for approval).
The application for type approval of the rear lamp shall be submitted by the holder of the trade name or mark or by his duly accredited representative.

The application shall be accompanied by drawings detailed enough to identify the lamp type and, if applicable, its category, showing: (a) the geometric position(s) in which the lamp (and if applicable the rear window) may be mounted on the vehicle; (b) the axis of observation used as reference axis in tests (H = 0°, V = 0°) and the centre of reference; (c) the limit of the apparent surface of the function(s); (d) the space reserved for the approval marking and its arrangement; (e) for replaceable source module(s), the module(s) and the space reserved for the specific identification code(s) on the lamp and on the module(s); (f) for an interdependent lamp system, the interdependent lamp or combination of interdependent lamps fulfilling the requirements; (g) for a lamp that may incorporate a vehicle manufacturer logo, that logo.

The application shall include a brief technical description stating in particular: (a) for lamps with replaceable UN approved light sources, the prescribed light source category or categories; (b) for lamps with replaceable light source module(s), the module specific identification code; (c) the make and type of electronic light source control gear(s) or variable intensity control(s), if any and if not part of the lamp; (d) if the lamp is also to be approved with LED substitute light source(s) per UN R128, the prescribed light source category or categories; (e) if a device is intended to be mounted inside the vehicle, the optical properties (transmission, colour, inclination, etc.) of the rear window(s); (f) for a lamp that may incorporate a vehicle manufacturer logo, a statement from the vehicle manufacturer confirming the logo is the official one for the brand name of the vehicle or body manufacturer.

Where a lamp type differs only by trade name or mark from an already approved type, the application may be limited to the documents specified in paragraphs 3.1.2.3.1 and 3.1.2.3.2 instead of the full documentation of 3.1.2.

For a lamp differing only by trade name or mark from an approved type, the application shall include a declaration by the lamp manufacturer that the submitted type is identical (except in trade name or mark) with, and produced by the same manufacturer as, the approved type, which shall be identified by its approval number.
For a lamp differing only by trade name or mark from an approved type, the application shall include two samples bearing the new trade name or mark, or equivalent documentation.
